title: MCP server is hand-rolled JSON-RPC, not an official SDK
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/McpServer.cs:12 implements initialize/ping/tools/list/tools/call directly over stdio; no ModelContextProtocol NuGet dependency in BrazilianSoccerMcp.csproj
suggestion: Acceptable — protocolVersion 2024-11-05 and the tools/list + tools/call contract are honored; noting as context, not a defect.

title: Fixture de-duplication can collapse distinct same-season matches with identical orientation+score
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/DataLoader.cs:140 keys dedup on (competition, year, homeKey, awayKey, homeGoals, awayGoals); two real fixtures at the same venue in one season ending with the same score would be merged
suggestion: Include round/stage or source in the dedup key; impact is minor (rare collision) and does not affect the requirement being met.

title: match_statistics does not surface the extended BR-Football columns (corners, shots, attacks)
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/DataLoader.cs:72 LoadExtendedMatches reads only date/teams/goals; home_corner/home_shots/home_attack columns are ignored
suggestion: Optional enrichment — the spec lists these as available but R10 only requires an aggregate statistic, which avg-goals/home-away rates/biggest-wins satisfy.
